title: Persistent eventual triple equation for one overlap test
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R a diagram of Noetherian commutative rings, c an affine limit cone of Spec(R), and f:X_i→Spec(R_i) a quasi-compact quasi-separated locally finitely presented morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-pc-base-change]. Fix j≥i, a finite affine open cover U of X_j, and finitely presented quasi-coherent modules N_a on its charts [pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose k≥j and natural overlap transitions T on U pulled back to X_k [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions] have components isomorphic to the pullbacks of N_a, and the limit pullback of T is coherent. Fix three charts a,b,d. There is l≥k such that at every m≥l the prescribed canonical refinement pullback of T satisfies T12 composed with T23 equals T13 on every chosen universal threefold overlap of these three charts, for any compatible family of chosen pairwise and threefold pullbacks.

source.place: Tag 01ZR, first proof (Zariski gluing), and clause (3); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01ZR

proof.text: Apply finitePresentation_overlap_triple_canonical_eventually to obtain a stage l and, at every later stage m, a family of chosen universal triple overlaps on which the composition equation holds.
For each later stage m, use overlap_triple_transport to transport the equation from that family to every supplied family of chosen pairwise and triple pullbacks. The same l works for all choices.

theorem finitePresentation_overlap_triple_eventually
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    [Finite U.I₀] [∀ a, IsAffine (U.X a)]
    (N : (a : U.I₀) → (U.X a).Modules)
    (a b d : U.I₀)
    (hN : ∀ a, (N a).IsFinitePresentation) (hNq : ∀ a, (N a).IsQuasicoherent)
    :
    ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let q₀ := overlapStageMap R f hij hjk
      let V₀ : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
        U.pullback₁ q₀
      let p₀ := overlapLimitMap R c f (hij.trans hjk)
      ∀ T : modulesPseudofunctor.OverlapTransitions V₀.f,
        (∀ a, Nonempty ((T.obj a : (V₀.X a).Modules) ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj (N a))) →
        (T.pull (p := p₀) (α := fun a ↦ a)
          (fun a ↦ V₀.pullbackHom_map p₀ a)).Coherent →
        ∃ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l), ∀ (m : I) (hkm : k ≤ m), l ≤ m →
          let q := overlapStageMap R f hij (hjk.trans hkm)
          let V : (pullback f (Spec.map
              (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjk.trans hkm)))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
            U.pullback₁ q
          let r := overlapStageMap R f (hij.trans hjk) hkm
          let s := overlapRefinementHom U q₀ q r
            (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkm)
          let T' := T.pull (p := r) (α := fun a ↦ a) (p' := s)
            (fun a ↦ overlapRefinementHom_map U q₀ q r
              (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkm) a)
          ∀ sq : ∀ x y, ChosenPullback (V.f x) (V.f y),
          ∀ sq₃ : ∀ x y z, ChosenPullback₃ (sq x y) (sq y z) (sq x z),
            T'.hom (sq₃ a b d).p (sq₃ a b d).p₁ (sq₃ a b d).p₂
                (sq₃ a b d).w₁ (sq₃ a b d).w₂ ≫
              T'.hom (sq₃ a b d).p (sq₃ a b d).p₂ (sq₃ a b d).p₃
                (sq₃ a b d).w₂ (sq₃ a b d).w₃ =
              T'.hom (sq₃ a b d).p (sq₃ a b d).p₁ (sq₃ a b d).p₃
                (sq₃ a b d).w₁ (sq₃ a b d).w₃
